name: Pizza With Cherry Tomatoes, Halloumi, Olives, and Mint

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella cheese, torn into small chunks, drained
halloumi cheese, cut into small cubes
thinly sliced scallions, light green and white parts only

instructions.primary_message: Divide dough into 4 equal parts and place each in a covered quart-sized deli container or a zipper-lock freezer bag. Allow to rest at room temperature for at least 2 hours before baking.
Adjust oven rack to 15 cm under broiler and place stone or steel on rack. Preheat oven to highest possible temperature (500 or 290°C (550°F)/260 or 290°C) for at least 45 minutes.

When ready to bake, turn one dough ball out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently press out dough into a rough 20-cm circle, leaving the outer 2.5 cm higher than the center. Gently stretch dough into a 25 to 30-cm circle, about 0.5 cm thick, by draping over knuckles and gently stretching. Transfer to floured wooden pizza peel.

Preheat broiler to high. Spread 1/4 of mozzarella over pizza, followed by 1/4 of halloumi, 1/4 of tomatoes, 1/4 of olives, and 1/4 of scallions. Sprinkle lightly with salt and drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

Transfer pizza to hot stone or steel and broil, rotating regularly for even cooking, until edges are puffed and lightly charred and bottom is crisp, 3 to 6 minutes total. Retrieve pizza with a metal peel and transfer to a cutting board. Allow to rest 1 minute. Sprinkle with 1/4 of mint, slice, and serve. Meanwhile, switch oven back to 290°C (550°F) to reheat stone for remaining pizzas.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 for remaining pizzas.

description: This pizza hits all the right notes, with briny olives and halloumi, fresh sweet cherry tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, and some fresh mint added right at the end.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 3 hr 15 min.

Optional substitutions: neapolitan pizza dough → 0.91 kg store-bought pizza dough
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
